optimizedDescription.value: Storage ports and fs adapters govern atomic, confined persistence, artifact drift, indexes, archives, locks, and runtime caches.

optimizedContext.value:
# Storage
## Rules
- Active directories: `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>` from `createdAt`; timestamp filesystem-only. `FsChangeRepository` resolves `*-<name>`. `ChangeRepository.list()` returns `createdAt` ascending via `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/changes/` index.
- Load derives artifact status from `validatedHash`: `__skipped__` → `skipped`; absent file → `missing`; cleaned SHA-256 match → `complete`; otherwise `in-progress`. Apply artifact-type `preHashCleanup` before hashing. Bypass derivation/drift when `artifactTypes.length === 0`.
- With resolved types, load detects baseline drift and calls `Change.invalidate("artifact-drift", SYSTEM_ACTOR, ...)` once with focused grouped payload; never use `ActorResolver`. Skip sentinel/already-reviewing files. Adapter persists resulting history when load path writes manifest. `ValidateArtifacts` handles consent-hash drift only.
- `projectArtifacts`/`effectiveStatus` own recursive `requires`: parent review may yield `pending-parent-artifact-review`; incomplete parent yields `in-progress`; skipped optional parent satisfies dependency. Rewrite persisted legacy `pending-parent-artifact-review` to `in-progress`; `ArtifactFile` rejects token. No `Change.effectiveStatus()`.
- Only `ValidateArtifacts` calls `Artifact.markComplete(hash)`; only skip use case calls `Artifact.markSkipped()` and writes `__skipped__`.
- `storage.archive.pattern` supports `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; default `{{change.archivedName}}`. Reject `{{change.scope}}`/`{{change.workspace}}` with `UnsupportedPatternError`; year four digits, month/day zero-padded.
- Archive listing index lives only at `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/archive/`: `.specd-index.jsonl` rows `{ entry, sourceMtime?, sourceFiles? }`; `.specd-index-meta.json` `{ totalCount, generatedAt, isInvalidated }`. `reindex()` rebuilds from manifests and removes legacy root index; normal cache hits neither scan nor delete root files. `get(name)` never requires root JSONL.
- Archive root `.gitignore` always ignores `.staging`; never restore obsolete index lines. Runtime creation, rebuild, staged-commit paths preserve hygiene. Named storage factories select adapters; workspace VCS/null-VCS decisions remain inside factory.
- `core:change-manifest` defines manifest/version/events. Writes atomic temp+rename. Reject root escapes and arbitrary untracked paths. Multi-update archive uses staged commit. Change locks: `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks`.
- Fs list caches: `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/{archive,changes,drafts,discarded,specs/<workspace>,validate-specs/<workspace>}/`; access through `FsChangeIndexCache`/`FsSpecIndexCache`; `include*` only projects response. Validation bucket meta extends shared shape with `schemaFingerprint`, `engineVersion`; rows `{ entry, stamps, cacheFingerprint }`; hosts expose no validate-cache reindex surface.
- First tmp use and project init idempotently create `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore` containing `*` and `!.gitignore`.
## Constraints
- Manifest writes atomic; serialized fs-cache paths use forward slashes on every OS.
- Directory timestamp comes from `change.createdAt`.
- `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/` runtime-only; never commit.
